definitions.response: Only Tauri-Response status header; no response body. Header arrival does not prove invoke Promise completion.
definitions.frontend: Same document performance clock for request, headers, actual await completion and state write.
definitions.backend: Separate process-monotonic clock; inclusive nested stage durations are not summed or subtracted from frontend durations.
definitions.pairing: Per-command ordinal pairing only when both command streams are serial and their counts agree. Otherwise concurrency is explicitly ambiguous.
